newsitem.title: USA: Moody's may upgrade John Alden New York.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may upgrade John Alden New York.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has changed its position on John Alden Financial Corp's John Alden Life Insurance Co of New York unit to a possible upgrade from uncertain.

The rating action follows John Alden's announcement that it entered into a definitive agreement to sell all of the common stock of John Alden Life Insurance Co of New York and substantially all of the annuity business of John Alden Life Insurance Co to SunAmerica Inc.

The insurance financial strength rating of John Alden Life Insurance Co remains on review for possible downgrade. That review will focus primarily on John Alden Life Insurance Co's small group health insurance business.
